run_replay_and_evaluate: run the CLI to replay HITL episodes in sim and evaluate task completion metrics
batch_process_session_file: batch process HITL session files across multiple CPUs and save results to a pickle file
eval_session: evaluate a HITL session by replaying all episodes and collecting per-episode metrics
get_metrics_episode_id: get frame-level metrics and object states for a specific HITL episode by episode ID
show_metrics: load processed episode results from a pickle file and print success rate and percent complete statistics
